Launch headless Edge with CDP; set viewport 320x800 and load executing project.
Capture executing: one static inset status card, no bubble/typing/percentage/internal stage.
Load confirm project; check the 20x20 confirmation checkbox; capture checked state; confirm no POST is sent.
Load failed project; capture failure in place; wait 900ms and confirm no automatic retry POST.
Load unknown project; capture exact 结果未知，正在核实 copy and only server-provided verify/retrieve actions.
Load recovered project; record pre-click top; click 恢复原任务; capture 已恢复 + 这一轮已完成 in the same region.
Repeat all five states at 768x1024 and 1440x900; verify no page-level horizontal scroll at 320 and card/CTA remains visible.
Collect computed styles, dimensions, network requests with requestId, and mock action stats.
Write v4-browser-result.json with 66 checks, 15 screenshots, and environment metadata.
